text: Coffee with Jasmine and Henrik. They finally set a date, wedding is early June in Bergen at his parents' place. Jasmine's vegetarian now, Henrik still eats anything. Remind me to ask Jasmine about the hen do sometime next week.
Nasser's daughter Rana starts reception on Monday morning. He's more nervous than she is tbh. She only eats plain pasta at the moment apparently.

Long call with Helen. Her son Ethan got his A level results Thursday, three A's, off to Leeds in September. She sounded so relieved. He wants a decent coffee machine for halls, could be a good present.
Dalia and Mihai's 10th anniversary is the 14th, they're doing dinner at that Romanian place at 8. Dalia's off dairy for her skin so check the menu if I end up joining. Mihai only drinks red.
Laila called off the engagement. Didn't go into it much but she's staying at her sister's for a bit. Need to check in on her at the weekend.
Elif's coeliac, properly, not just avoiding bread. Remember that for the barbecue.

Bumped into Michael at the school gates. His twins finish primary end of the month and there's a leavers' assembly on the 23rd at half 2. He's dreading it, he'll cry apparently. Wife's away so he's on his own with it.
Dawit passed his driving test this morning!! Third time lucky. His mum's buying him a little Fiat. Send congrats tonight.

Joy says Wei proposed on the beach in Cornwall last weekend. Ring is his grandmother's. They're thinking spring next year for the wedding, nothing booked. Joy doesn't drink so the celebration drinks were all mocktails, which she loved.
Finn hates coriander. Like genuinely gags. Noted for future dinners.
Oisín's graduation is Friday at 11 in the Aula Max. His parents are flying over from Galway on Thursday evening. Don't forget to get him a card before then.
Pick up gluten free flour and oat milk on the way home. Book the car in for an MOT sometime next week.

Ava and Joe are expecting! Due early March. She's been really sick in the mornings, can barely look at coffee, which for Ava is tragic. Joe's already painting the box room. I should drop round some ginger biscuits for her.
Lindiwe's little boy Sipho has his first swimming gala Saturday at 9am. She said he's been practising every night after tea.

Catch up with Claire. Her and her partner Salma celebrate five years together end of next month, thinking of a weekend in Lisbon. Claire mentioned Salma's been eyeing a proper espresso cup set, hint hint. Salma's also gone vegan since January.
Gintaras was telling me his daughter's sitting her Lithuanian school leaving exams over the summer, back home. He's going over for a fortnight in July to be with her.
Rana and Ioana are both doing Dry January again, so no wine for the dinner on the 9th. Ioana likes those ginger beers from the deli though.
Ahmed sounds wiped. Newborn is fine but they're not sleeping at all. His wife Kalani's mum is staying till sometime next week to help. Remind me to text Ahmed on Friday to see how he's holding up.
Met Kieran's fiancée Caitlin properly for the first time. Lovely. She's a nurse at the Royal, does nights mostly. Allergic to shellfish, carries an EpiPen. Wedding's next August apparently.
Lunch with Aneesh. His son starts secondary on Wednesday, the big one with the blazer. Aneesh is fine, his wife less so. Kid wants to try out for the football team.
Lars's parents' ruby anniversary is on the 30th. Big family lunch Sunday the 2nd at 1pm, he's asked me to come and I'm bringing a dessert. His dad's diabetic so something low sugar.
Hannah got into her Masters at Edinburgh! Starts mid September. Must send her something nice this week.
Jasmine said Henrik's brother Nils is getting married too, same summer, so it's a double wedding year for that family. Henrik is best man and terrified of the speech.
Note to self. I'm doing the cake for Ethan's party, I'm off work that Friday anyway.
Nasser's cooking for everyone on Eid again. He doesn't eat lamb though, which surprised me. Big fan of anything with pistachio.
Helen was saying her mum's 80th is sometime in early April, they're thinking of a surprise tea party. Her mum loves Earl Grey and lemon drizzle. Ask Helen nearer the time if they need help with food.
Dalia's nephew had his first day at nursery yesterday, cried the whole morning, fine by lunchtime. She's soft on him.
The wedding fair with Laila on Saturday is off, she's not up for it. Instead we're getting brunch Sunday at 11.
Elif's daughter Defne has her GCSE mocks starting the week after next. She's in bits about maths. Elif asked if I could help her revise one evening, said yes, Tuesday after 6.
Michael and his wife Joy renewed their vows last month, tiny thing in the garden. Joy's now gone pescatarian which Michael is trying to keep up with.
Message from Dawit. His sister Hiwot graduates from nursing school on the 19th at 10am. Whole family's driving up the night before. Don't forget to ask him how it went.
Wei says Finn's started eating meat again after eight years veggie. Bacon was the first thing. Unbelievable.
Chat with Oisín after training. He and Ava split up, the engagement's off. He's staying with his brother Cian for now. He's not great. I need to call him over the weekend, maybe take him for a pint.
Joe wants nothing for his birthday but he did say twice that his headphones are dying.

Ran into Lindiwe and Claire at the market. Lindiwe's eldest Thabo is doing his first exams at uni in January and is pretty stressed. Claire's on a low FODMAP diet for her stomach. Lindiwe makes the best bobotie, she's promised to share the recipe.
Mihai's son Luca lost his first tooth tonight. Mihai FaceTimed me just to show me the gap. Tooth fairy is apparently paying a pound.

Salma's parents' 50th wedding anniversary is the end of the month, there's a party at the community hall Saturday the 28th from 7. She asked me to bring a halal option. Her dad loves baklava. Remind me to order some from the Turkish bakery on Thursday morning.
Gintaras and his wife Rūta are hosting a christening for the baby sometime in early spring. Rūta doesn't drink, Gintaras very much does.

Phone call with Ioana. She's on a strict low carb thing for her blood sugar, doctor's orders. Her husband Ahmed is doing it with her in solidarity and moaning a lot. Their daughter's prom is next Friday evening.
Kieran's mum is doing a cookery course at the college starting after half term, Wednesday evenings. Never seen him so proud.
Need to buy a wedding present for Caitlin and Kieran before the end of the month. They've got a list on John Lewis.
Kalani told me she's nut allergic, the serious kind. Good to know before I bring brownies anywhere near her.

Aneesh and Lars. Aneesh's wife is graduating with her PhD on the 7th, ceremony in the morning, lunch after. Lars is coming too, he was her supervisor years ago. Aneesh is planning a surprise dinner at that Keralan place. I should get her flowers for the day.
Hannah's dog Biscuit had his op yesterday, all went fine, very sorry for himself. She's taking Friday off to stay home with him.

Lunch with Jasmine, Helen and Dalia. Jasmine's wedding menu tasting is Saturday the 11th at 2, she's stressing about the vegan options. Helen's daughter Maya just started Year 1 and loves it. Dalia's gone off coffee completely, says it's a migraine thing. Helen wants us all over for drinks sometime over the summer.
Ethan's girlfriend Laila is doing her bar exams end of February. He says she's studying ten hours a day and barely eating. Remind me to send her something good luck the week before.
Morning run done, meal prep tonight. Dentist Thursday at 4.
Michael mentioned his brother Joe is getting engaged at Christmas, it's a surprise so keep quiet. Ring is already bought.

Dawit's son is doing his 11 plus on Saturday morning. Poor kid's been doing past papers every night. Dawit wants to take him out for pancakes after. I must text Dawit on Saturday afternoon to see how it went.
Joy only drinks oat flat whites, extra hot. And Wei's a matcha person. For the office coffee run.

Finn & Oisín have been together 3 years Thursday. Finn's booked a table at the oyster bar for 7:30. Oisín is allergic to oysters, which Finn has somehow forgotten. Not my business. Actually maybe text Finn.

Caught up with Lindiwe on the phone. Her mum's recovering from the hip op and Lindiwe's back and forth to Durban a lot. Her daughter Zola finishes primary in December. She's exhausted but says it's fine.
Mrs Andersson next door says her granddaughter got into the Royal Ballet School. Starts in September. She's over the moon.
Salma and Mihai are off to a cousin's wedding in Bucharest in early May. Mihai's doing a speech, in Romanian, and is a wreck about it. Ask him how it went when they're back.

Dinner at Rana's. She's moved to a fully plant based diet and her cooking is unreal. Her son Adam is doing his GCSE results day stuff in August and wants to do sixth form at the college. Her husband's very quiet, works in finance. She asked if I'd come to her 40th, Saturday 15th from 8.
Ioana was saying her kids both start at the new school after Easter. Little one is excited, the older one less so.
Uncle Ahmed's retiring end of the month after 30 years at the hospital. Big do on the Friday at 6. Remember to chip in for the leaving gift by Wednesday.
Kieran says his partner Caitlin passed her midwifery exams. Graduating sometime in the autumn. He's thrilled.
Henrik doesn't drink coffee, only tea, black, no sugar. Odd for a Norwegian.

Gave Aneesh a lift home. His daughter Priya has her Grade 5 piano exam Wednesday at 10 and she's been really anxious, crying over scales. His wife's working that day so he's taking her. Remind me to text Priya good luck on Tuesday night, then ask Aneesh how it went Wednesday evening.
